scope: Four-record signal capture pilot; no glucose or clinical alarm claim
hr_definition: 60 / median RR seconds; retain RR in [0.3,2] for both reference and candidate; >=5 intervals
interpretation: Record choice and defaults fixed before scoring; convenience pilot, not complete MIT-BIH validation. End-of-window extraction may use any sample within the past window; no zero-latency claim. Test labels never tune detector settings.
